title: Find a tenant and check their balance
description: From the dashboard to a tenant's payments (three pages).

steps.title: Find a tenant
steps.text: Let's open a tenant's profile and check what they owe, starting from the side menu.

steps.title: Open People
steps.text: Tenants are under People. Click People to expand it.

steps.title: Open Tenants
steps.text: Click Tenants to open your tenant list.

steps.title: Search the list
steps.text: Type part of a name, email, or phone number to narrow the list.

steps.title: Filter
steps.text: Show only tenants who owe money, or only those who are paid up.

steps.title: Open a profile
steps.text: Click this tenant to open their profile.

steps.title: Balance
steps.text: What this tenant owes right now. Red means it's past due.

steps.title: Payment history
steps.text: Click Payments to see every payment and whether it was on time.

steps.title: That's it
steps.text: You found a tenant, checked their balance, and looked at their payment history.
